Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ১) Which tribe has the largest population in Bangladesh?
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: Chakmas, the largest ethnic tribe in Bangladesh. They also call themselves Changmas. They are concentrated in the central and northern parts of the Chittagong hill tracts where they live amidst several other ethnic tribes.

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ৩) Who was the first lieutenant governor of the newly formed province in 1905?
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: Sir Joseph Bampfylde Fuller was a British inventor, writer and first Lieutenant Governor of the new province of Eastern Bengal and Assam, knighted for his service in India

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ৪) The Montreal Protocol is adopted-
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp:
Montreal Protocol on Substances that Deplete the Ozone Layer.
Montreal, 16 September 1987
Entry into force : 1 January 1989, in accordance with article 16(1).
Registration: 1 January 1989

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ৫) Krishak Sramik Party leader-
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp:
AK Fazlul Huq's political strategy was to make the rural elite his power base. It is evidenced by his initiative in founding the short-lived Calcutta Agricultural Association (1917), and yet another short-lived organisation called Bengal praja party.
Huq's faction of the Samiti changed its nomenclature to krishak praja party (KPP) in 1935

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ৬) Dhaka's Big Katra and Small Katra are located in which area of ​​Dhaka city?
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: Shaista Khan, was a great builder. His own palace was built of wood, probably for its cooling effect, but he built a Katra, now known as chhota katra, to distinguish it from the Bara Katra of Shah Shuja. He also built a number of mosques and tombs; of the mosques Chaukbazar mosque, Babubazar mosque and Sat Gumbad mosque are prominent; of the tombs Bibi Pari's tomb is the most prominent.

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ৭) What is the original name of the Awami League?
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: Bangladesh Awami League one of the oldest and major political parties in Bangladesh. It is the Awami League that played the leading role in achieving the independence of Bangladesh. The Awami League was founded in Rose Garden of KM Das Lane, Dhaka on 23 June 1949 at a convention of the leaders and workers known to be a faction of the Bengal Provincial Muslim League headed by huseyn shaheed suhrawardy and abul hashim.

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ৮) When did Father of the Nation Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman officially announce 6 points?
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: Six-point Programme a charter of demands enunciated by the awami league for removing disparity between the two wings of Pakistan and to put an end to the internal colonial rule of West Pakistan in East Bengal.

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ৯) Where is Swatch of No Ground located?
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.option2: খ) In the Bay of Bengal
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.option3: গ) At the mouth of the Meghna
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: Swatch of no Ground a trough-shaped marine valley or canyon that cross the continental shelf diagonally and situated on the south of the Ganges-Brahmaputra delta. It is also known as Ganga Trough.

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ১০) In which article of the Constitution is the issue of Administrative Tribunal inserted?
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: No Explanation Added

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ১১) What is the name of the film based on Bir Shrestha Matiur Rahman?
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: Matiur Rahman (died 20 August 1971) was a flight lieutenant of Pakistan Air Force and a recipient of Bir Sreshtho, Bangladesh's highest military gallantry award for his actions during the Liberation War of Bangladesh.

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ১২) What was the main theme of the second Arab-Israeli war?
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.option4: ঘ) Establishment of the state of Israel
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: The Suez Crisis, or the Second Arab–Israeli war, also called the tripartite aggression in the Arab world and Sinai War in Israel, was an invasion of Egypt in late 1956 by Israel, followed by the United Kingdom and France.

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ১৩) Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman received for his contribution to peace-
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: World Peace Council awarded Julio Curie Peace Prize to Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman for his being a symbol of world peace on May 23, 1973.

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ১৪) Who is the first Asian Winner of Nobel Prize?
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: Asians have been the recipients of all six award categories: Physics, Chemistry, Physiology or Medicine, Literature, Peace, and Economics. The first Asian recipient, Rabindranath Tagore, was awarded the Literature Prize in 1913. The most Nobel Prizes awarded to Asians in a single year was in 2014, when five Asians became laureates. The most recent Asian laureates, Japanese scientist Akira Yoshino and Indian economist Abhijit Banerjee were awarded their prizes in 2019.

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ১৫) Who was known as Iron man of India?
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: Vallabhbhai Jhaverbhai Patel, popularly known as Sardar Patel, was an Indian politician. He served as the first Deputy Prime Minister of India.

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ১৬) The chief administrative office of the UNO, which co-ordinates and supervises the activities of the UNO, is
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.option1: ক) the International court of justice
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: The chief administrative office of the UNO, which co-ordinates and supervises the activities of the UNO, is the secretariat. The secretary-general, the principal administrative officer of the United Nations, is elected for a five-year renewable term by a two-thirds vote of the General Assembly and by the recommendation of the Security Council and the approval of its permanent members.

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ১৭) Oscar Awards were instituted in
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: Oscar Awards were instituted in 1929. The 1st Academy Awards ceremony, presented by the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences (AMPAS), honored the best films of 1927 and 1928 and took place on May 16, 1929, at a private dinner held at the Hollywood Roosevelt Hotel in Los Angeles, California.

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ১৮) Each year World Red Cross and Red Crescent Day is celebrated on
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: Each year World Red Cross and Red Crescent Day is celebrated on May 8. This date is the anniversary of the birth of Henry Dunant, who was born on 8 May 1828.

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ১৯) Epsom (England) is the place associated with
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: Epsom (England) is the place associated with Horse racing. Epsom is a market town in Surrey, England, 22.0 km south-west of London. Epsom Downs Racecourse holds The Derby, now a generic name for sports competitions in English-speaking countries. The town also gives its name to Epsom salts, extracted from mineral waters there.

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ২০) Grand Central Terminal, Park Avenue, New York is the world's
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: Grand Central Terminal, Park Avenue, New York is the world's largest railway station. GCT is the largest train station in the world in terms of area occupied and number of platforms. The terminal is spread over 49 acres and has 44 platforms.

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ২১) The term 'Butterfly Stroke' is associated with
২২) The most salty basin in the world is the
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: The most salty basin in the world is the Dead Sea. Its surface and shores are 427 metres below sea level, Earth's lowest elevation on land. The Dead Sea is 306 m deep, the deepest hypersaline lake in the world.

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ২৩) Nautical mile is a unit of distance used in
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: Nautical mile is a unit of distance used in Navigation. A nautical mile is a unit of measurement used on water by sailors and/or navigators in shipping and aviation. It is the average length of one minute of one degree along a great circle of the Earth. One nautical mile corresponds to one minute of latitude.

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ২৪) Great Barrier Reef, the world's largest Coral reef is located in
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: The reef is located off the coast of Queensland, Australia, in the Coral Sea. Stretching for 1,429 miles over an area of approximately 133,000 square miles, the Great Barrier Reef is the largest coral reef system in the world.

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ২৫) The tropical rain forests in the Amazon basin is known as
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: The tropical rain forests in the Amazon basin is known as Selvas. The Amazon rainforest, covering much of northwestern Brazil and extending into Colombia, Peru and other South American countries, is the world’s largest tropical rainforest, famed for its biodiversity. It’s crisscrossed by thousands of rivers, including the powerful Amazon.

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ২৬) As a result of the partition of Bengal announced by Lord Curzon in 1905, Bengal was partitioned into two provinces of
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.option1: ক) East Bengal and West Bengal
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.option2: খ) Bengal and Eastern Bengal & Assam
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.option4: ঘ) Bengal and Odisha and East Bengal and Assam
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: As a result of the partition of Bengal announced by Lord Curzon in 1905, Bengal was partitioned into two provinces of Bengal and Eastern Bengal & Assam.

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ২৭) Who was the first Governor General of Bengal?
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: Warren Hastings is the first British Governor General of Bengal. He took the charge as a Governor General on 20th October,1773

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ২৮) Who was the governor-general during the Revolt of 1857?
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: Lord Canning served as Governor General of India from 1856 to 1862. During his tenure, the Government of India Act, 1858 was passed which created the office of Viceroy to be held by the same person who was Governor General of India. Thus, Lord Canning also served as first Viceroy of India.

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ২৯) Raja Rammohan Roy organised a historic agitation against the
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.option3: গ) Degrading position of women in society
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.option4: ঘ) Practice of superfluous religious rituals
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: Ram Mohan Roy launched an attack on Sati that “aroused such anger that for awhile his life was in danger”.

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ৩০) The French East India Company was founded in
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: Jean-Baptiste Colbert founded the French East India Company in 1664.

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ৩১) Akbar had constructed several forts, which did not include the one of
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: The fort is called Red Fort or Lal QiIa because it is made of red sandstone. The history of forts indicates that it was built between the year 1639-1648 by the Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan in old Delhi.

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ৩২) When was NATO signed?
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: The organization implements the North Atlantic Treaty that was signed on 4 April 1949. NATO constitutes a system of collective defence whereby its independent member states agree to mutual defence in response to an attack by any external party.

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ৩৩) When did the October Revolution occur?
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: Bolshevik Red Guards forces under the Military Revolutionary Committee began the occupation of government buildings on 7 November 1917 (New Style).

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ৩৪) The currency of Thailand is
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: Baht banknotes and coins issued by the Bank of Thailand. The baht is the official currency of Thailand. It is subdivided into 100 satang. The issuance of currency is the responsibility of the Bank of Thailand.

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ৩৫) Which U.S President announced the ''New Deal'' for economic recovery in the aftermath of the Great Depression?
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: The New Deal was a series of programs and projects instituted during the Great Depression by President Franklin D. Roosevelt that aimed to restore prosperity to Americans. When Roosevelt took office in 1933, he acted swiftly to stabilize the economy and provide jobs and relief to those who were suffering.

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ৩৬) Which one was the capital city of Byzantine Empire?
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: Constantinople was re-inaugurated in 324 from ancient Byzantium as the new capital of the Roman Empire by Emperor Constantine the Great, after whom it was named, and dedicated on 11 May 330. The city was located in what is now the European side and the core of modern Istanbul.

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ৩৭) The famous painting 'Monalisa' was the creation of
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: Monalisa is the famous creation of Italian Renaissance artist Leonardo-da-Vinci. It is acclaimed as the most livable work of art.

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ৩৮) The world's oldest continuously inhabited city is
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: Damascus is the capital city of Syria and the oldest inhabited city in the world.

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ৩৯) What was the name of the atom bomb dropped in Hiroshima city?
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: Little Boy was the code name for the type of atomic bomb dropped on the Japanese city of Hiroshima on 6 August 1945 during World War II. It was the first nuclear weapon used in warfare.

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ৪০) When did the Third Battle of Panipat take place?
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: The Third Battle of Panipat took place on 14 January 1761 at Panipat, about 60 miles (97 km) north of Delhi, between a northern expeditionary force of the Maratha Empire and invading forces of the King of Afghanistan, Ahmad Shah Abdali, supported by two Indian allies—the Rohillas Najib-ud-daulah, Afghans of the Doab region and Shuja-ud-Daula-the Nawab of Awadh.

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ৪১) In U.S.A. the President is elected by-
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: The US President is elected indirectly and the elections are held in accordance with the system of Universal Adult Franchise.

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ৪২) Which civilization is known as the birthplace of democracy?
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: The concept of a democratic society, such as the one our country enjoys today, began in the Greek capital some 8,000 years ago. The city of Athens is sometimes referred to as the cradle of Western civilization. Athens began as a hilltop fort on the Acropolis.

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ৪৩) Who was popularly known as Africa's Gandhi?
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: Nelson Mandela is known as ''South African Gandhi''. He also used the Gandhian principles of 'Passive Resistance' and 'Satyagraha' as effective political tool.

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ৪৪) When was the first of the Geneva Conventions on the treatment of war victims adopted?
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: The First Geneva Convention for the amelioration of the condition of the wounded in armies in the field, held on 22 August 1864, is the first of four treaties of the Geneva Conventions. After the first treaty was adopted in 1864, it was significantly revised and replaced in 1906, 1929, and finally 1949.

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ৪৫) The Hundred Years' War (from 1337 to 1453) was fought between
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: The Hundred Years' War was a long struggle between England and France over succession to the French throne. It lasted from 1337 to 1453, so it might more accurately be called the ''116 Years' War.''

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ৪৬) During the First World War, which country signed the Peace Treaty (1917) with Germany?
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: In December 1917, Germany agreed to an armistice and peace talks with Russia, and Lenin sent Leon Trotsky to Brest-Litovsk in Belarus to negotiate a treaty. The talks broke off after Germany demanded independence for Russian holdings in Eastern Europe, and in February 1918 fighting resumed on the eastern front. They signed the Peace Treaty.

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ৪৭) 'Popping Crease' is associated with which games?
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: The odd name of the popping crease refers to the early history of the game of cricket, when batsmen used to have to 'pop' their bats into a small hole that was located in the middle of the crease for a run to count. For a player to run a batsman out, he had to pop the ball into the hole before the bat was grounded in it.

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ৪৮) Strait of Malacca separates ________.
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: Strait of Malacca separates Sumatra and Malaysia. The Strait of Malacca (also called the Straits of Malacca, and in Malay Selat Melaka) is a narrow stretch of water between Peninsular Malaysia (West Malaysia) and the Indonesian island of Sumatra.

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ৪৯) What is the modern name of ''Siam''?
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: The south eastern Asian country of Thailand was earlier known by the name of Siam.

Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.question: ৫০) Black forest is found in
Basic General Knowledge: Bangladesh and.exp: Black forest is found in Germany. It is a mountainous region with dense, evergreen forests in South West Germany bordering France and surrounded by Rhine Valley.
